month_order = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June","July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]

fig = px.line(df.groupby("Month_Name", as_index=False)["Sales"].sum()
.assign(Month_Name=lambda x: pd.Categorical(x["Month_Name"], categories=month_order, ordered=True)).sort_values("Month_Name"),
x="Month_Name",y="Sales",markers=True,text="Sales")

fig.update_traces(texttemplate="$%{text:,.0f}",textposition="top center",cliponaxis=False)

fig.update_layout(title="MONTHLY SALES TREND",title_x=0.5,xaxis_title="MONTH",yaxis_title="SALES",height=700,width=1100,template="plotly_dark")

CONCLUSION¶

  1. Canon imageCLASS 2200 Advanced Copier recorded the highest sales and the highest profit among all products.

  2. Phones recorded the highest sales among sub-categories, while Copiers recorded the highest profit.

  3. Monday recorded the highest sales, while Sunday recorded the highest profit.

  4. November recorded the highest sales, while December recorded the highest profit.

  5. The Consumer segment recorded the highest sales and profit.

  6. Sean Miller recorded the highest sales among customers, while Tamara Chand recorded the highest profit.

  7. Standard Class was the most frequently used shipping mode, with 5,968 orders.

  8. The Product ID → Category and Product ID → Sub-Category relationships were consistent. However, inconsistencies were found in the Product ID → Product Name relationship. These records require further investigation before deciding whether to correct, flag, or remove them.

RECOMMENDATIONS¶

  1. Focus on high-performing products: The company should continue promoting high-performing products such as the Canon imageCLASS 2200 Advanced Copier, which generated the highest sales and profit.

  2. Strengthen the Phones and Copiers categories: Since Phones generated the highest sales and Copiers generated the highest profit, the company should prioritize these sub-categories through targeted promotions, inventory planning, and product expansion.

  3. Investigate monthly sales and profit patterns: Since November had the highest sales while December had the highest profit, the company should analyze the factors behind these results and use them to improve seasonal sales and profitability strategies.
